goal_objective: Advance feat/market-data-provider-platform: Implement the approved US-first multi-provider market-data platform plan: canonical FIGI-based identity and issuer model; exchange/session calendars; market-series scoped raw/canonical OHLCV with local rollups and adjustments; provider capability/entitlement/quota routing; US universe/lifecycle, events, SEC fundamentals, FINRA short interest, current options with local high-fidelity Greeks, optional futures and crypto providers; backend admin/diagnostic APIs; and disabled 30-day shadow monitoring. Backend/data only; do not modify frontend or ETF constituent provider work.. Acceptance criteria: AC-IDENTITY: New and reconciled US-listed securities use stable FIGI-domain keys where applicable, issuer identity is separate from security identity, effective-dated listing/provider-symbol history is retained, and unresolved candidates are quarantined without silent merges.; AC-SERIES: Canonical bars distinguish instrument, market/feed scope, session, timeframe, adjustment basis/version, and provenance; existing OHLCV reads remain compatible through a default series mapping.; AC-CALENDAR: Exchange sessions, timezones, holidays, early closes, overnight trade-date rules, and user-local projections are versioned and used by freshness and daily-completion logic.; AC-ROUTING: Provider routing filters by capability, asset/venue/session/interval/history/feed/terms entitlement, health, quota, and workload budget; quota reservations are safe across workers and every decision is observable.; AC-REFRESH: Whole-universe core-session D1 refresh, tiered intraday polling, local rollups, exact missing-slice repair, request coalescing, deferred broad-evaluator runs, and automatic retry are implemented without provider calls inside evaluation loops.; AC-DATA: Provider adapters cover the approved practical roster, with US identity/lifecycle, OHLCV, corporate actions, market events, SEC facts/core fundamentals, earnings, FINRA short interest, crypto, current options, and optional futures paths represented honestly by capability and provenance.; AC-OPTIONS: Current option chains and quotes are retained; QuantLib-backed American-option Greeks and the existing fallback are labeled with model/version/input provenance and tested against numerical edge cases.; AC-OPS: Backend-only admin and diagnostic APIs expose capabilities, entitlements, quota/cost usage, routing decisions, coverage, identity quarantine, sessions, queue/degradation state, anomalies, and detailed shadow reports.; AC-SHADOW: New routing defaults remain disabled until a separately approved deployed 30-day shadow run produces automated daily/final reports, at least 99% eligible core-session D1 coverage before the next regular session, no silent identity/license/quota violations, and AI-readable discrepancy evidence.; AC-COMPAT: Existing symbol-based API aliases and legacy yfinance-dependent paths remain functional only through explicit compatibility behavior; yfinance is absent from default and acceptance routing.; AC-TEST: Focused unit, adapter-fixture, migration, PostgreSQL/Redis integration, worker, API, numerical, point-in-time, and full backend integration validation pass; no frontend files are modified.. Required local profile: docker_integration. Stop at ready_for_human_review; do not integrate, promote, deploy, or modify another worktree.
